experiment: Schema commitment vs representational strain: does the early-token effect survive the middle spectral band?

instrument_provenance.verified_independently: 17/17 tests pass, 12/12 mutants killed, source restored clean, checksum matched — run on MTH by Lyra, not taken on report
instrument_provenance.method_credit: Banding, Gavish-Donoho threshold, MP path, aperture guard, null gate and windowed mode are CC's, extracted from 51b_moe_advanced_analysis.py. Lyra contributes the question, the windows (from decision-state), and the design.

motivation: On 2026-09-07 Lyra relabelled the decision-state 'confidence paradox' (d=0.91) as SCHEMA COMMITMENT, on the source paper's own analysis: the effect is structural (formulaic uncertainty templates with predictable next tokens) and carries a temporal profile d=1.02 preamble / 0.89 early content / 0.37 at p>0.08 deep content. A synthesis was then written into meta-pattern section 'Six of the Ten Are One Kill': six of ten falsified results died of one mechanism, a response-surface property explaining the variance, which might be a READOUT rather than a confound. CC's Exp 51 decomposition threatens exactly this: their component 1, representational strain (token frequency/familiarity), OWNS THE TOP OF THE SVD SPECTRUM, and stable rank (sum(s^2)/s_max^2) is top-dominated. The preamble is high-frequency boilerplate. So the early-token effect and the top-band confound may be one phenomenon measured two ways, in which case schema commitment IS the confound and the synthesis describes an artifact. This experiment is pre-registered to be able to retract it.

hypothesis.H1_commitment: Middle-band count (top band excluded by construction) differs between honest and confabulated trials, AND that difference is larger in token windows 0-7 and 8-19 than in 20-49. The condition x window interaction survives the switch from stable rank to middle-band count.
hypothesis.H0_deflationary: The honest/confab difference appears in STABLE RANK but NOT in middle-band count. Schema commitment is representational strain. Consequence: retract the meta-pattern 'Six of the Ten Are One Kill' interpretation, keep the timing measurement, and the six kills close as six design errors rather than one finding.
hypothesis.falsifier: H1 is falsified if the condition x window interaction on middle_band_count fails to reach alpha=0.05 at question-level cluster bootstrap WHILE the same interaction on stable_rank does reach it, with aperture_ok true and the planted-signal positive control passing. That conjunction is a positive result for H0_deflationary and triggers the retraction named above.

method.model: One dense HF model with per-token KV cache access (Qwen3-8B class). MUST use the model's own tokenizer — a substitute tokenizer produces garbage output (established lesson).
method.device: Starship GPU (reported clear 2026-09-05). GPU is required ONLY for generation and cache capture; all analysis is numpy/CPU and already built.
method.dataset: SimpleQA. Short factual entity questions with external ground truth.

labelling.confabulated: confident-form answer that does not match ground truth
labelling.critical_note: Confidence is a MEASURED COVARIATE, never a selection criterion. Selecting 'confident but wrong' would select on a correlate of the outcome. Labels come from external ground truth alone.

method.system_prompt: UNIFORM across all trials. This is the exact control whose absence collapsed our deception AUROC from 1.000 to 0.160, and the one CC's Exp 51 ran.

capture.mode: two-phase (encoding, then generation), manual generation loop
capture.C1_guard: model.generate() is NOT called anywhere in the capture path — it rebuilds the cache and invalidates the geometry. One forward pass per token, K read off the cache after each step. Do not pass position_ids on a hybrid-cache model.
capture.L1_guard: No hooks fire during generation. Cache is read from the returned object between steps, so observation cannot alter behaviour.
capture.TOKEN_AXIS_MANDATORY: Writes K[trial, token, dim]. NOTHING averages before it lands on disk. Rationale: an audit on 2026-09-07 found our ENTIRE saved-geometry corpus is token-averaged at capture (emo_k_L0_H0 is (200,64) trials x dims with no token axis; Project-Oracle *_cache_L22.npy are (1024,) steering vectors whose filenames say 'cache'). If schema commitment is real, every experiment we have run could have contained it and no saved artifact could have shown it.
capture.also_saved_per_token: logit margin and logit entropy (S1) — required to speak to the decision-state result and to diagnose a stable-rank reproduction failure as plumbing vs absence

matrix_shape.construction: K at one layer, concatenated across 4 KV heads x 128 head_dim = 512 dims; ~31 generated tokens
matrix_shape.aperture_note: aperture_ok() MUST be checked on the REALISED shape after capture, not the planned one. A shape drift into gamma<2.0 closes the band and every count reads 0.
matrix_shape.DO_NOT_STACK: CC retracted the stacking advice after measuring: at 310x512 GD_lo=46.53 vs MP_hi=46.07, span -0.46. The edges CROSS, the band inverts, and it returns 0 for every input forever. A closed band and an empty band are the same number. 31x512 is inside the working window; the 'fix' was outside it.

windows.provenance: Taken VERBATIM from the decision-state paper. NOT re-chosen. Re-picking windows after seeing the data is the analysis flexibility this programme exists to prevent.

repeats.N_eff_rationale: NO REPEATS. Greedy decoding with k repeats yields byte-identical outputs and therefore identical K. Mine 4 v3 died exactly here: 810 apparent rows, 54 DISTINCT feature vectors, permutation null a point mass that could not reject under any data. Variance comes from the question sample, which is the inferential unit anyway. If sampling is ever introduced, N_eff must be computed as len(set()) over realised feature vectors BEFORE any statistic is read.

seeds.M2_guard: Global seed fixed and recorded in the artifact; per-trial seed = seed_base + question_index so a single trial is reproducible without replaying the run.

method.C3_guard: IDENTICAL code path for both conditions. Condition is a property of the label assigned after ground-truth comparison, not of the prompt template or a code branch. There is no experimental/control fork because there is no manipulation.
method.n_questions: minimum 40 usable per condition after exclusions; question set FIXED IN ADVANCE

analysis.inferential_unit: THE QUESTION. Not the token, not the trial, not the window. Mine 4 v3 died on this exact point.
analysis.primary: middle_band_count ~ condition * window, with question-level clustering. THE DIAGNOSTIC IS THE INTERACTION, not a main effect: does the condition x window pattern present in stable rank survive in middle-band count?
analysis.secondary_paired: stable_rank on the SAME trials and SAME windows. Its job is to REPRODUCE the known top-band-contaminated effect. If stable rank shows no effect either, the run failed to reproduce a published finding and NOTHING about the middle band is interpretable — that is a plumbing failure, not a null.
analysis.statistics: Question-level cluster bootstrap, 10000 resamples. Condition labels permuted WITHIN window. alpha = 0.05 on the interaction.
analysis.power: Target MDE: interaction d >= 0.5 at 80% power, COMPUTED AT QUESTION LEVEL before capture and recorded here on completion.
analysis.stopping_rule: Question set fixed in advance, analysed ONCE. No peeking, no adaptive extension. If underpowered, that is a finding about the design, not a licence to add questions until it moves.
analysis.fwl: FWL residualization on token count, WITHIN FOLD (53/60 sign-flips without it). Note: adding a near-zero-variance second regressor can artifactually INCREASE separability — if double-FWL beats single-FWL, that is an artifact, not an improvement.

controls.name: aperture_ok(m, n) on realised shape
controls.if_it_FAILS: Band closed -> count=0 for every input -> reads as 'no signal' -> MANUFACTURES THE RETRACTION. Run must return usable=False, never a null.

controls.name: null_band_count() at actual n
controls.if_it_FAILS: Floor is non-zero -> a positive count is not automatically signal -> the 'presence vs structural absence' framing is void and everything needs a distributional test.
controls.if_it_SUCCEEDS: Floor is 0 (CC: 120 trials, gamma 2.0-25.6, empty every time) -> any positive count is signal by construction.

controls.name: planted-signal positive control at the realised shape
controls.if_it_FAILS: Instrument cannot see a signal we put there -> ANY NULL IS UNINTERPRETABLE. Blocks the run.
controls.if_it_SUCCEEDS: Band count rises with planted amplitude (CC observed [0,1,2,3,6] at 31x512) -> a null means absence, not blindness.

controls.name: stable-rank reproduction (secondary endpoint doubling as control)
controls.if_it_FAILS: Known effect absent -> plumbing failure -> do not interpret the primary.
controls.if_it_SUCCEEDS: Middle-band comparison is against a working baseline.

threats_to_validity: T1: ASYMMETRIC CONTROL FAILURE. Two controls (aperture_ok, planted-signal) fail TOWARD Lyra's retraction. That is the safer direction to be wrong in, but a null result is only interpretable with BOTH green. Stated explicitly because four times this month a control's failure mode manufactured the result it guarded.

T2: Token-count confound. Honest and confabulated answers differ in length. FWL within fold; and note the deep-content window (20-49) is only reachable by trials that generated >=20 tokens, so window membership is not independent of length. Report per-window n.
T3: Post-hoc labelling. Condition is assigned from model output against ground truth, so condition is not randomised. This is observational. No causal claim is made about what the model 'decided'.
T4: Single model, single layer. No claim of scale- or architecture-invariance from this run.

T5: The windows are borrowed from a DIFFERENT experiment on a DIFFERENT model. If the response-template structure differs, the windows may not align with the same phases. Report token-position histograms so misalignment is visible.

T6: SimpleQA entity questions may correlate knowledge with token frequency by construction — rare entities are both less known and less frequent. This is the confound the middle band is meant to exclude, so it is the whole point; but if the middle band ALSO tracks it, the design cannot separate them. Report the frequency-matched subset as a check.

implications.if_H1_holds: Schema commitment survives exclusion of the representational-strain band. The middle-band count is the instrument for it, and the meta-pattern synthesis stands with a spectral mechanism attached: six results died in a band we can name, bound, and exclude.
implications.if_H0_deflationary_holds: Schema commitment is representational strain. RETRACT the meta-pattern section 'Six of the Ten Are One Kill' interpretation while keeping the timing measurement. The six kills close as six design errors. This is a clean, publishable null that closes six open questions with one result.
implications.if_partial: The interaction survives in some windows and not others, or the effect is present but attenuated. Report the attenuation with the band counts per window and do NOT round toward either narrative. A partial result must not be written as if it were H1.
implications.if_controls_block: If aperture_ok is false or the planted-signal control fails, NO conclusion is drawn in either direction and the run is reported as instrument-blocked. An uninterpretable run must not be reported as a null.

compute.gpu_needed_for: generation and per-token cache capture only
compute.analysis: numpy, CPU, already built and independently verified
compute.gate_condition: NOTHING LAUNCHES UNTIL THIS PASSES AGNI. Three designs rejected this month; the fourth should not be launched on enthusiasm.
